name: Plugin data not updating on cached pages
query: We store ratings in a custom table and show them on product pages, but visitors see old ratings until the cache expires.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Purge the affected post when a rating changes (clean_post_cache plus guarded cache-plugin APIs)
Step 3: Expose a plugin action so hosts/CDNs can hook in
Step 4: Prefer narrow purges or LiteSpeed tags over purge-all
success_criteria: Works without any cache plugin installed
